$comment: CRD municipalities for bin signage. We deliberately do NOT assert a per-municipality accept list for compostable cups: the CRD organics programme does not accept non-fibrous compostable containers, and municipal rules change. Signage states what the cup IS (certified home compostable) and links the municipality's own current programme. Getting this wrong is a greenwashing exposure for Cup Casa, not just for the café — see docs/SPEC.md, 'Bin signage generator'.

regionalProgramme.name: CRD kitchen scraps / organics
regionalProgramme.note: The regional organics programme is built for food scraps and soiled paper. Non-fibrous items marketed as compostable — containers, cutlery, cups — are not part of it, and are pulled out at the sorting line.
